about: StickLLM verified list. Generated by scripts/pins.py manifest; do not edit by hand.

blocked_apps.code-server-jupyter: Not packaged and security-reviewed for the stick yet (a full terminal and package installs).
blocked_apps.comfyui: Needs CUDA, PyTorch and the GPU the model is using; not containerised for the stick yet.
blocked_apps.immich: Needs Postgres, Redis and a machine-learning container (four containers) plus a GPU for search.
blocked_apps.jitsi: Four containers including the Java video bridge, and calls need LAN/internet UDP.
blocked_apps.matrix: Federation and bridges need internet and LAN access; add-on containers have no network.
blocked_apps.n8n: Fair-code licence (not OSI open source) and it duplicates Node-RED, which ships.
blocked_apps.onionshare: Command line plus Tor, which needs internet; no web app to open.
blocked_apps.opentimestamps: Command-line tools with no web app; timestamping needs internet calendars.
blocked_apps.paperless-ngx: Needs Redis plus OCR worker containers; StickLLM add-ons are one locked-down container each.
blocked_apps.postiz: Node, Postgres and Redis, and posting needs internet access to the social networks.
blocked_apps.searxng: Already built into Agent Zero (its own private search); a second copy adds nothing.
blocked_apps.simplex: Relay servers only, used from phone and desktop apps; nothing to open in a browser tab.
blocked_apps.snappymail: Webmail needs outbound IMAP/SMTP, and add-on containers have no network by design.
